title: Img2Num — HTML + IIFE Example
description: Convert a raster image to SVG in the browser with Img2Num, using a plain script tag (IIFE bundle) — no bundler, no module system.
heading: Img2Num IIFE Example Application
intro: A simple demo app showing how to use Img2Num's JavaScript library from a plain <script> tag. The IIFE bundle exposes a global Img2Num object.
